title: Backend change log
description: Turns on the change log of a resource: its creates, updates and deletes in the changelog schema, and GET :id/changes.

name.description: Resource name, singular or plural (e.g. invoice).

partition.description: Give the resource a partition of changelog.change of its own (a migration of @dafne/backend-database-changelog); otherwise its rows go to change_default. `dafne g backend-changelog` asks.

app.description: Backend app the resource's lib is registered in (apps/<app>).
